items.note: Never mentions the Plant Care Guarantee claim steps (My Orders, two photos, 2-day review). It also hints a Support Lead 'may be able to make an exception' and asks for box photos, which is a DOA requirement. It does say the guarantee gives a replacement, not a refund.
Accurate on the 48-hour DOA window and the guarantee claim steps (30/90 days, two photos, 2-day review, replacement, no return needed). Escalation is offered without promising an outcome.
Gives safety advice first and notes pothos is not pet-safe. It never escalates to a Support Lead, which the rules require for safety issues.
Tells them to contact a vet or poison control, but does not escalate to a Support Lead. The advice is thin, and 'toxic' goes slightly beyond the KB wording.
Handles the pending-authorisation check, last four digits and the 3-day refund correctly. It omits the multi-parcel possibility, and it says 'I can process', which slightly overpromises.
Covers pending authorisations, the multi-parcel possibility, last four digits only and the 3-day refund. It does not promise a same-day refund.
Wrongly says Plant Care Guarantee issues must be reported within 48 hours, mixing it up with DOA. Otherwise correct that live plants can't be returned and about shipping.
Correct on the main points and adds the non-living returns detail. It claims not to have the guarantee details, though they are in the KB, which is a gap.
Correctly says no redirect or address change is possible. It adds the courier investigation route. It does not offer to escalate, but this is minor.

Correctly says redirects aren't possible, but then tells the customer the courier may be able to redirect. That implies a workaround the KB doesn't support. It also misses the courier investigation route.
All Plus facts are accurate, including no free Express and the refund conditions.
Accurate and complete. It is honest about not being able to judge whether Plus is worth it.
Correctly refuses the refund, benefits continue, gives the cancel path and offers escalation.
Correct on eligibility and offers escalation. It says it doesn't know how to cancel, though the Subscriptions path may apply, which is a minor gap.
Doesn't state that there is no phone support, and implies a Support Lead may arrange a callback, which is invented. It also misses the email address and the chat hours.
Says it doesn't know whether phone support exists, when the KB says there is none. It offers to ask for a call and omits the email address and chat hours.
